purpose: D21 zero-training bidirectional gate transplant and max_det saturation diagnosis
scientific_boundary: Checkpoint transplantation is off-manifold. It localizes frozen-checkpoint sensitivity but does not prove training-time causality, backbone pollution, or resource transfer between scales.

preregistered_thresholds.candidate_saturation_dominant: AP-L and AR-L gap shrink from max_det500 to 1000 both >=50%
preregistered_thresholds.Gate-dominant: B AP-L/AR-L recovery >=50% and D AP-L/AR-L damage reproduction >=50%
preregistered_thresholds.Whole-SDG-dominant: B AP-L/AR-L recovery <25% and C AP-L/AR-L recovery >=50%
preregistered_thresholds.Shared-trajectory-like: C AP-L/AR-L recovery <25% and D AP-L/AR-L damage reproduction <25%

next_formal_experiment.rationale: A gate-only frozen transplant is insufficient; the lowest-change retraining test is to cut the direct RSG auxiliary gradient to shared P2/P3/backbone representations.
constraints: Do not train ordinary LDSP-E22; overlaps prior E12a LDSA/E19a RCFA directions.
Any General Gate + Bounded Small Residual must detach the descriptor on the RSG auxiliary path.
Gradient-Isolated RSG may claim only that the direct auxiliary gradient is cut; indirect training-trajectory effects remain possible.
